title: Khatti
resume: Pick up where your pen left off.
protonote: Personal practice · local to this browser. Geometry feedback measures similarity to the selected model.
coursedesc: Meet your pen, explore its movement, and build the first forms. Take your time.
tracetip: Begin at the numbered marker. Follow the arrow.
copytip: Study the specimen above. Write on the blank page.
recalltip: Write from memory. You can reveal the specimen anytime.
paper: A little space to find your flow
unsaved: Practice works here; browser storage is unavailable.
nibdesc: A broad edge creates thick and thin marks.
locked: Lesson nib is fixed to keep practice comparable. Switch to free studio to experiment.
hardware: Stylus detected · pressure only when variable
resulttry: A good place to keep practising.
resultsub: One small adjustment makes the next attempt better.
good: You followed the movement and completed the form.
strengthshape: You found the outline of the form.
strengthtry: You made time to practise. Keep going.
missing: Add the remaining strokes and marks.
short: Follow the full stroke rather than tapping.
start: Begin at the marked start and follow its direction.
direction: Follow the arrow from the beginning of the stroke.
coverage: Carry the stroke all the way to its endpoint.
shape: Keep the movement closer to the guide; avoid retracing.
dot: Place a compact mark inside the dot guide.
extra: Use the intended strokes; undo any extra marks.
nextmemory: Try the form from memory, with the reference hidden.
nextreview: Revisit this form another day, or explore the next lesson.
nextgood: Try the same form without the tracing guide.
estimate: Prototype similarity estimate, not an expert assessment.
emptysub: Finish a practice and your ink will be saved in your own collection.
gallerynote: Saved in this browser. The latest 24 practices are kept.
clearask: Clear the ink on this page?
abouttitle: A working studio, made for testing.
aboutsub: Explore the learning flow, pen feel and feedback before integration.
about1: Practise with a finger, stylus, or mouse. Drawing currently requires visual guidance and pointer input; there is no keyboard or screen-reader drawing alternative.
about2: Bism has calligrapher approval reported by the user on 21 October 2026. The reviewer’s identity and written sign-off remain unrecorded. Allah movements remain draft.
about3: Practice stays local to this browser. Model similarity and qualifying attempts do not establish independent mastery, and are not sent to XP, streaks, or mosque rankings.
about4: This standalone uses an English, left-to-right interface. Arabic teaching text retains its natural right-to-left shaping.
about5: Finger mark thresholds are provisional. Recorded good and bad finger/stylus attempts are still required for release calibration. Each model also needs a named reviewer and written sign-off; Allah remains draft.
comingdesc: Each script needs its own teacher-reviewed movements and proportions. Start with the Naskh pilot while this collection takes shape.
storageerror: Your browser could not save this practice. Export it to keep a copy.
limit: This page is full. Clear it or check your practice.
recallhint: No tracing guide in Recall. Use Show specimen for a separate reference.
freehint: Free studio · feedback checks shape and movement, not your chosen nib.
drawing: Let the ink follow your hand.
presshint: Make one compact Qalam mark at the guide.
keyhint: Use your finger, stylus or mouse to draw.
deleteallask: Delete all saved practice and drafts in this prototype?
allink: All expected strokes drawn. Check when you are ready.
journeySub: From the first movement to a complete, vocalized word — a quiet introduction to Qur’anic calligraphy.
journeySteps: Six small steps. One first piece.
reviewRequired: Bism is reviewed. New word studies are labelled separately.
reviewDetail: The Bism text reference is the opening word of Al-Fatihah 1:1. Your reported calligrapher approval covers the six v2 Bism teaching models. New word studies retain a separate review status. Noto Naskh Arabic supplies the typeset reference, not an inferred stroke order.
foundationsLink: Want to meet the pen first?
foundationsSub: Nine short exercises to explore nib marks, lines, curves and letter forms.
addingMarks: Add the dot and vowel marks
bodyNote: Body construction study. The dot and vowel marks are added in the next step.
marksNote: Place the marks on the prepared body. This scaffold remains visible in each mode.
wordNote: Include the ba dot, both kasras and the sukun. This is an opening word, not a complete ayah.
inspectWord: See the word and its marks
bodyStart: Ba: descend and make the first connection.
sinMove: Sin: keep the three teeth distinct and connected.
mimMove: Mim: form the head and return to the connection.
mimTail: Mim: lift, then draw the descending tail.
baDot: Ba: add one compact dot below.
baKasra: Ba: place the kasra below the dot.
mimKasra: Mim: place the kasra below the head.
finishSub: Keep your own writing on a quiet page. The reference stays separate from your handwritten study.
modelPreviewSub: See the movement model on a finished page. This is a model preview, not your writing.
referenceHiddenSub: Use Show specimen in settings if you need it.
firstPieceReady: Your first word is taking shape.
firstPieceNext: Try it without a tracing guide, then make a piece to keep.
pieceEligible: Complete all required strokes and marks before finishing this piece.
noReligiousScore: Feedback estimates shape and movement. It does not assess recitation or religious merit.
reviewReported: Calligrapher approval reported by you on 21 October 2026 for the v2 Bism models. Reviewer identity is not recorded.
approvedNote: Calligrapher-reviewed Bism model. Practise the movements, then gradually reduce the guides.
newDraftNote: New movement study · calligrapher review pending. The vocalized text reference is available.
basmalaIntro: One word at a time. Then a complete composition.
allahSub: Build the upright forms, connect the final shape, then add the shadda, small alif and kasra.
allahLamOne: First lam: descend and turn into the connection.
allahLamTwo: Second lam: descend and complete the next connection.
allahHa: Final ha: form the enclosed head and connect it.
allahShadda: Add the shadda above the doubled lam.
allahSmallAlif: Place the small alif above the shadda.
allahKasra: Place the kasra below the final ha.
allahBodyNote: Body construction study. Add the vowel marks in the complete-word exercise.
allahWordNote: Keep the alif separate from the following lam. Include the shadda, small alif and kasra.
comingWord: The typeset reference is ready. This word’s guided movement lessons are still being prepared.
reportScope: Approval covers the existing v2 Bism studies only. It is not extended to newly authored words or to a learner’s own writing.
